title: ChainPrune: Evaluating and Reducing Redundancy in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.21860v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly enhanced the multi-step problem-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by introducing explicit intermediate reasoning. However, advanced Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often exhibit overthinking behaviors, including excessively long reasoning steps, redundant steps, and high computational overhead. Existing token-length reward strategies aim to promote concise outputs, but often result in pseudo-conciseness, where token count is reduced, yet redundant reasoning persists, leading to longer and less structurally efficient chains. To address these limitations, we propose ChainPrune, a novel reasoning path semantic structural optimization method to efficiently and controllably synthesize self-generated high-quality training data. translated_title: 链剪枝：评估并减少长思维链推理中的冗余
translated_abstract: 思维链推理通过引入显式的中间推理步骤，显著增强了大语言模型的多步问题解决能力。然而，先进的大型推理模型常常表现出过度思考的行为，包括过长的推理步骤、冗余步骤和高计算开销。现有的令牌长度奖励策略旨在促进简洁输出，但往往导致伪简洁，即令牌数量减少，但冗余推理仍然存在，导致推理链更长且结构效率更低。为解决这些限制，我们提出了ChainPrune，一种新颖的推理路径语义结构优化方法，用于高效且可控地合成自生成的高质量训练数据。我们首先将自生成的推理路径整合为基于树的结构，然后进行多标准主导路径选择过程。
tldr: 本文提出ChainPrune方法，通过树状结构整合和多标准路径选择，有效减少长思维链推理中的冗余，避免伪简洁问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ChainPrune, a semantic structural optimization method that consolidates reasoning paths into a tree structure and applies multi-criteria selection to reduce redundancy in long chain-of-thought reasoning, avoiding pseudo-conciseness.
